content.title: The Busyhead Project on Instagram: "Make sure to check out @noahkahanmusic’s new documentary on @netflix! These are some of our favorite quotes from “Noah Kahan: Out of Body” on Mental Health 🤍"
content.text: Make sure to check out @noahkahanmusic’s new documentary on @netflix! These are some of our favorite quotes from “Noah Kahan: Out of Body” on Mental Health 🤍so appreciate you and your vulnerability in sharing your story and helping others feel less alone. ❤️“I’m not curing it, but I am definitely walking near it and poking it with a stick… ‘What are you?’” One of many parts that stood out to me 🫶He hit the nail on the head with that first quote when it comes to mental health ❤️ 😔Absolutely brilliant, honest and raw documentary!!! 🙌❤️Love it! Thanks for sharing 🙌Can’t wait to watch! Thank you for inspiring us. 🙏🏻♥️A beautiful, raw, and wonderful documentary. Grateful to Noah for sharing his struggles. And his many gifts and immense talent. Sending ❤️🙏🏻 for more joy and peace as he continues to grow and evolve and experience life. He deserves the best!i know that noah will never see this but im still gonna write it-Noah you and your music saved my life. i was really struggling with life and i was about to end it when youre gonna go far started playing on my computer. i had never listened to your music prior to this so me listening to this song in that exact moment was an act of God. i started sobbing because i realized how much it would affect not only me but my family. you helped me quit self harming and suicidal thoughts. im still struggling especially since my family doesnt believe in mental health, but you will never have any idea how much you have helped me and are still continuing to help me. your music makes my struggle and pain feel seen and your music has honest to God saved my life. what i wouldnt give to meet you and be able to really honestly thank you for everything you have done for me. you're my favorite artist and ive listened to your music for 76 hours these past 4 months. thank you. forever.so grateful for @noahkahanmusic and his willingness to be so open, honest, and vulnerable. thank you for allowing so many people to be seen!Please put his documentary off Netflix onto DVDs for people to buy, all proceeds could go to busy bee, just sayinnnn ❤️ ❤️ @noahkahanmusic
